description:
On your upkeep, activate Words of Wilding by paying {1}.
On your draw step, create a Bear token.
Activate a Bear token by tapping itself, adding two mana of any colors.
Activate World of Wilding by paying {2}.
Activate Greater Good by sacrificing a Bear token, creating two Bear tokens and discarding three cards.
Activate a Bear token by tapping itself, adding two mana of any colors.
Repeat from step 4.
